Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP pressure, CC immunity, Seiton, warnings, assists, and target clarity.
Description: A local PvP HUD integrating pressure and CC-protection cues, Ninja Seiton decisions, personal and MCH LB warnings, opt-in CC macro assist/help, self-Purify and BRD/WHM ally rescue, plus target highlights.
Changelog: Adds opt-in /nearhelp and /sshelp plus CC-only BRD/WHM Ally Rescue. Paean/Aquaveil can make one attempt for Stun, Silence, Deep Freeze, or Miracle on the exact reachable party member chosen by HP, incoming pressure, trusted MP, and distance. Self-Purify wins shared input; no helper retries. Near Help keeps the /mlock + <2> then <t> fallback without a visible target switch.
